notes: The perfect column is a greedy hindsight candidate, not an upper bound; some rows force unprofitable peak calls. forward_summary also reports max(hindsight,no call), which is still not an upper bound.
The platform field uses none=0 as no programme; for an already enrolled fleet platform cost is common to all operating choices and must not influence daily dispatch.

Forward development periods were previously inspected, and inherited energy profiles and forecast uplift use the 2026-06-30 cutoff. No causal policy executed an energy-labelled call in this run; this does not validate the full historical price-forecast pipeline.
